supplementaryEvidence.title: Marsita Omar, Adelphi Hotel, Singapore Infopedia, NLB
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read article body through Closure: the later hotel occupied 1 and 2 Coleman Street at North Bridge Road; the hotel closed in 1973 and the present Adelphi Complex was built on the same site. This distinguishes that site from the earlier 3 Coleman Street hotel address.

supplementaryEvidence.title: National Museum of Singapore, The Adelphi Hotel, accession 2001-03461
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read catalogue description: the hotel’s final location was North Bridge Road/Coleman Street and the replacement building is The Adelphi. The NLB article gives more precise closure/demolition chronology; no catalogue image is reproduced.

supplementaryEvidence.title: Arkib Negara Malaysia, Penubuhan Malaysia 16 September 1963
supplementaryEvidence.read: Read article body, chronology and photograph caption: Tunku addressed the foreign correspondents at Adelphi Hotel, Singapore, on 27 May 1961 when proposing federation. This directly connects the event to the hotel whose replacement site is identified by NLB.

reviewRecommendations.reason: Pasir Salak is an unrelated nineteenth-century conflict site. NLB ties the 1948 trigger to Sungei Siput. Use the documented town/district reference, explicitly not the estate murder sites.
Arkib Negara directly identifies the proclamation venue, so a generic city point is unnecessary. Keep approximate for the exact platform.
Arkib Negara explicitly locates the federal proclamation at Stadium Merdeka. Distinguish this from local ceremonies in Singapore/Sabah/Sarawak.
NLB final-site identification plus the single OneMap building match supplies a sourced present-site point. Do not use the earlier Adelphi address at 3 Coleman Street.
Kampong Glam describes the later Singapore establishment and supplies no departure point. The island reference represents the source locality in Riau, with no invented departure jetty.

reviewRecommendations.recommended: jakarta if the event primarily represents the policy announcement; retain Kuching only if explicitly identified as an approximate Borneo-theatre anchor
reviewRecommendations.reason: The event note currently distinguishes January announcement and later military incursions, whereas Kuching city represents neither exact event venue. A broad theatre reference needs explicit contextual wording; Jakarta is the sourced city reference for the political-announcement interpretation.

Independent NHB Civic District booklet and MCCY account tie today’s Arts House vicinity to the Temenggong settlement. This supports the place relationship, while the exact treaty location remains unknown.
NLB puts camp about five miles from town, so the explicit locality-scale limitation is essential. Town centre must not be captioned as actual camp.

reviewRecommendations.recommended: Use documented representative/reference point rather than geographic centroid unless the property explicitly supplies a centroid. Keep approximate.
reviewRecommendations.reason: P625 is a documented representative coordinate, not necessarily a measured geometric centre. Singapore P5140 is explicitly geographic centre, so its use for island-wide constitutional/census events is distinct.

reviewLimit: This is an anchor-place relationship review, not fresh verification of all event chronologies or the full geographic footprints. Other mappings are reasonable locality references under their stated caveats; no exact-venue acceptance is implied.
